newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek elections sideline investors, cash rates hold.
newsitem.headline: Greek elections sideline investors, cash rates hold.

text.p: Greek depos and forex forwards were idling in narrow ranges in late listless trade with investors remaining on the sidelines awaiting the outcome of elections on Sunday.
"It has been business as usual with rates unmoved all day long," said a dealer. "We are all waiting for the election results on Sunday."
Interest rates will tumble on Monday if the socialists win, he said.
The socialists are strong advocates of a strong drachma and lower interest rate policy mix and they would keep it in place if they win on Sunday.
The conservatives place a premium on spending cuts and privatisation and favour a softer drachma policy.
Both parties are running neck and neck but the electoral law is structured in such a way as to produce a winner if the margin between the first and the second party is tiny.
The mark was quoted at 158.70/80 drachmas from Friday's 158.845 fix, the dollar at 240.70/80 drachmas from 240.860 and the Ecu at 301.51/61 from 301.650 drachmas.
